insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and applies to orders updated after August 31, 2026. The mutation now returns the updated taxes based on the new shipping destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their apps to handle the new tax calculations when updating shipping addresses. This change may require modifications to existing code that relies on the orderUpdate mutation. Developers should test their apps to ensure they can handle the updated tax calculations. The GraphQL Admin API will return an error if the mutation is not properly formatted. Developers can use the orderUpdate mutation with the new shipping address to recalculate taxes.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations when updating shipping addresses on unfulfilled orders. This change ensures that merchants are charged the correct amount of tax based on the new shipping destination.
insight.why_it_matters: This change ensures that tax calculations are accurate and up-to-date, which is essential for merchants to comply with tax laws and regulations. It also improves the overall shopping experience for customers.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and there have been patch updates to @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen. These updates improve the toolkit and extend the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. Additionally, updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes through the orderUpdate GraphQL mutation.

themes.title: Ecosystem Updates
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and POS UI extensions can print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API. Shopify Functions API version 2026-10 adds a createdAt field to the Customer object, allowing for more precise Function logic.
